purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Haragach

queries.query: Haragach Bangladesh cadastral map land records official; Bangladesh official cadastral parcel map GIS Haragach Rangpur
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS) official map-search service, the official integrated online map-purchase portal, and the Ministry of Land map portal. The current public map portal's location inventory identifies Haragach as a mouza in Kaunia, Rangpur, with an RS map record. No open parcel vector endpoint was found.

queries.query: হরাগাছ বাংলাদেশ মৌজা নকশা ভূমি রেকর্ড সরকারি; হরাগাছ রংপুর ভূমি রেকর্ড মানচিত্র সরকারি
queries.result: Bangla first-party discovery identified the same DLRS and Ministry of Land services. Direct public API lookup returned Rangpur division, Rangpur district, Kaunia upazila, and the Haragach mouza spellings হারাগাছ/হারাগাছ চতুরা. The public inventory returned an available digitized RS map for হারাগাছ, JL ৩, sheet ২. No parcel feature geometry or parcel-level native ID response was exposed.

registryEvidence: The official DLRS map portal exposes the Haragach mouza hierarchy and an available digitized RS map inventory record for Kaunia, Rangpur. This evidences a local cadastral/map service custodian and a map inventory, but not an open parcel feature service.

officialSources.observation: Official DLRS Integrated Online Map Purchase System; current JavaScript exposes public location, map-search, and map-detail routes. It describes CS, SA, RS, BRS, and BDS survey maps.

Bounded anonymous public search returned one available digitized RS map record: inventory id 717896987571195000, mouza হারাগাছ, JL ৩, sheet ২. The response is map inventory metadata, not parcel geometry.
Official DLRS legacy map viewer; current JavaScript exposed division, district, survey, thana, mouza, sheet, dag, and sheet-JSON routes.
Official Ministry of Land land-map service landing page; public page describes mouza-map access, but no anonymous parcel vector response was obtained.

source: Bangladesh Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS) official map portal / settlement.gov.bd

requestOutcomes.outcome: TLS-default GET succeeded; current JavaScript/configuration was inspected. It exposed public location and map-search routes, but no parcel vector service.
TLS-default GET succeeded; returned Bangla division names including রংপুর.
TLS-default GET succeeded; returned Rangpur-division districts including রংপুর.
TLS-default GET succeeded; returned Kaunia among Rangpur upazilas.
TLS-default GET succeeded; returned Haragach-related mouza names হারাগাছ, হারাগাছ চতুরা, হারাগাছা, and হারাগাছা চতুরা.
TLS-default GET succeeded; returned sheet numbers ২ and ৪.
TLS-default GET succeeded; returned survey type আর.এস.

TLS-default bounded search succeeded; returned one map inventory record with safe public id 717896987571195000, status AVAILABLE, and isDigitized true. No geometry, parcel identity, or schema was returned.

TLS-default anonymous POSTs succeeded for division, district, and survey discovery. The Rangpur district response exposed an RS/BRS digital survey entry, but the subsequent thana route returned an empty list; no sheet JSON or parcel geometry was retained.

nativeIdentityCandidates: public map inventory id 717896987571195000; not a parcel identity
schemaAndCrs.qualification: Not qualified as a parcel layer: returned records are purchasable mouza map inventory metadata and did not include parcel-level geometry or parcel identity.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Bangladesh DLRS map-search and integrated map-purchase services for the Haragach mouza in Kaunia, Rangpur.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Haragach mouza and a digitized RS sheet-2 map inventory record were verified. Citywide parcel coverage, vector schema, CRS, and anonymous parcel access were not verified.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
remainingUncertainty: The official portal may provide raster/download or authenticated/purchase-mediated mouza maps, and the legacy viewer may expose sheet JSON after additional current UI state is supplied. The exact WUP point was preserved and not used as an absence test. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested. No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe native parcel identity and full parcel polygon were observed. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
